scripts.ci: vp run ready && vp run test:browser && vp run test:audits && vp run new-app
scripts.release: node packages/remy-cli/src/remy.ts release check && CHECK_LOCALES=all vp run ci && vp run template:check && vp run ui:verify && vp run publish:rehearse && node packages/remy-cli/src/remy.ts test cwv && node packages/remy-cli/src/remy.ts packages tag
scripts.setup: node packages/remy-cli/src/remy.ts setup check && node packages/remy-cli/src/remy.ts setup install && node packages/remy-cli/src/remy.ts skills install && node packages/remy-cli/src/remy.ts rules && node packages/remy-cli/src/remy.ts mcp register && node packages/remy-cli/src/remy.ts verify && vp run ready
scripts.ui:components: shadcn add button card input label badge alert field separator direction skeleton empty sidebar breadcrumb collapsible dropdown-menu avatar sheet tooltip navigation-menu use-mobile table spinner tabs --overwrite --yes -c apps/remy-auth
scripts.ui:blocks: shadcn add @shadcn/sidebar-16 -c packages/remy-ui --diff src/blocks/sidebar-16/components/app-sidebar.tsx && shadcn add @shadcn/sidebar-16 -c packages/remy-ui --diff src/blocks/sidebar-16/components/nav-main.tsx && shadcn add @shadcn/sidebar-16 -c packages/remy-ui --diff src/blocks/sidebar-16/components/site-header.tsx
scripts.ui:verify: vp run ui:theme && vp run ui:components && vp fmt packages/remy-ui/src/components packages/remy-ui/src/hooks packages/remy-ui/src/styles apps/remy-auth/src/lib && git diff --exit-code -- packages/remy-ui/src/components packages/remy-ui/src/hooks packages/remy-ui/src/styles apps/remy-auth/src/lib
